review.scope: Follow-up completion adapter and actual sparse-context preparation. Verify original-reply comparison, missing-marker recovery, private exact source copy, bounded private Git stderr capture, terminal-trigger validation and escaped coordinator envelope. Prior c5 review approved source only; b79 changes are not installed. Review no patient execution or live grants.
findings: VERIFIED (original-reply comparison): every stage_result advancement, at all three positions, re-reads both original broker replies through a recovery-mode BrokerStages that can only issue stage_status, byte-compares each round-1 artifact against the parsed broker answer (CAMPAIGN_ARTIFACT_ORIGINAL_REPLY_MISMATCH), re-validates receipt bindings on each replay (per-stage requested_model, exact claude-fable-5 actual_model for review, returncode 0, answer_sha256, packet_sha256 against the caller packet, operating_context_sha256 format), and binds each on-disk provenance record to the live broker receipt via model_receipt_sha256 (CAMPAIGN_ORIGINAL_MODEL_RECEIPT_CHANGED). Combined with completed_pipeline's exact artifact-set/hash, request-context, initiator event/packet, and APPROVE checks, the mutable local receipt.json can no longer stand alone as proof; consistent local tampering of receipt plus artifacts still fails against the protected broker's originals before any coordinator advancement or bookkeeping.

VERIFIED (missing-marker recovery): the lost recovery.json completion in stage_result runs only when output is the projection, requires recovered_original:true in both provenance files that are themselves hash-bound into the verified artifact set (CAMPAIGN_RECOVERY_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED), requires symlink-free JSON equality between original and projection request.json (CAMPAIGN_RECOVERY_ORIGINAL_REQUEST_CHANGED), and rewrites byte-identical canonical content (same original_request_sha256/event/packet fields as recover_projection) so the immutable write is idempotent when the marker already exists. Preservation of scientific approvals holds: a REVISE original writes no receipt at the enforced max_rounds=1, completed_pipeline additionally requires verdict APPROVE, round 1 and status REVIEWED_PROPOSAL_NOT_ADOPTED, an incomplete projection blocks with CAMPAIGN_RECOVERY_INCOMPLETE_NO_RETRY, and conflicting or symlinked round-1 originals refuse before projection creation (RECOVERY_PRESERVES_CONFLICTING_ORIGINAL). This completes the prior review's third suggestion.

VERIFIED (private exact source copy): preparation_workspace inventories only git-tracked names, refuses absolute/'..'/'.git' components and symlinked leaf paths, skips unmaterialized entries, enforces 2MB per file / 50MB total / 2000-entry bounds, creates the destination 0700 under a private_root-verified parent with exclusive-create 0600 files, re-hashes source bytes at copy time (CAMPAIGN_SOURCE_CHANGED), and writes the immutable manifest last so a partial copy refuses as CAMPAIGN_WORKSPACE_RECONCILE_NO_RETRY instead of silently re-copying. Every reuse re-verifies each copied input's hash and symlink-free path (CAMPAIGN_WORKSPACE_INPUT_CHANGED), preserving human edits as named refusals; the exact copy including .gitignore stays private controller state, not model output or publication.

VERIFIED (bounded private Git stderr capture): git_diagnostics keeps stderr and a hashed JSON receipt in a directory validated as absolute, non-symlink (lstat after mkdir defeats the swap race), owner-matching, mode 0700, and not inside any git checkout; files are 0600 and fsynced. Exceptions carry only the opaque receipt directory name, never argv, stdout, or stderr; stdout/stderr/shell overrides are refused; callers receive empty stderr with stdout intact; timeouts and start failures produce distinct sanitized exceptions. preparation_workspace converts SubprocessError/RuntimeError into named CAMPAIGN_SOURCE_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE, and OSError/ValueError from the diagnostics root remain inside Runtime.recover's and tick's caught tuples — closing the prior uncaught-subprocess-error crash in the recovery path.

VERIFIED (terminal-trigger validation): Runtime.__init__ now refuses, before Coordinator or any state creation, an installed campaign_preparation whose trigger_job is not a configured synthetic_execution pair with a None successor (CAMPAIGN_TERMINAL_TRIGGER_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED), eliminating the previously possible permanently blocked CAMPAIGN_COMPLETION_BINDING_REQUIRED combination where ingest builds an execution_proposal for the trigger. enqueue_report still requires trigger verified-completion with execution_proposal None, stage_result re-verifies exact equality with the root-owned installed contract and refuses synthetic successors (CAMPAIGN_TASK_REFUSES_SYNTHETIC_SUCCESSOR), and the broker independently re-validates the version-1 P001 readiness/discuss artifact contract. No new socket operation, credential, admission grant, scheduler, or patient route is added.

VERIFIED (escaped coordinator envelope): BrokerStages.call validates the escaped JSON of the entire broker response at 80000 bytes in both fresh and recovery modes — not only the unescaped answer — before any receipt-binding acceptance or artifact write, and the model prompt states the same budget. This leaves headroom under the shared 100000-byte public-text default for the coordinator's receipt wrapping and the small added campaign fields in stage_result's returned envelope; the CJK fixture demonstrates an answer whose UTF-8 bytes pass but whose escaped envelope refuses with PUBLIC_TEXT_REJECTED and no files written.

SUGGESTION (unnamed startup failure on explicit null): with campaign_preparation installed and synthetic_execution present but explicitly null, config.get('synthetic_execution',{}) returns None and .get('pairs',{}) raises an unnamed AttributeError instead of CAMPAIGN_TERMINAL_TRIGGER_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED; elsewhere the runtime treats null as absent. Fail-closed (startup crash, no state created), but use (config.get('synthetic_execution') or {}) for the named refusal; a non-dict pairs value can similarly raise TypeError at pairs[trigger] before CompletionBridge validation runs.

SUGGESTION (minor residuals, all fail-closed): '-c safe.directory' is honored only in Git >=2.38 protected command scope, so older git fails the inventory as CAMPAIGN_SOURCE_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE on split-ownership checkouts rather than working as commented; the private stderr file is time-bounded by the caller's 30s timeout but has no byte cap; the first-pass source walk checks only leaf symlinks, relying on checked_source cleanliness for intermediate directories, while the destination-side reuse check does verify full parent chains; ancestor-wide is_symlink checks in recover_projection and workspace reuse can false-refuse under symlinked mount points; and handover_coordinator.py was again not supplied, so the coordinator's receipt persistence accommodating the <=80000-byte envelope plus added campaign fields is inferred from the shared text() default, not directly verified.

SCOPE NOTE: source-only author-operated review under the existing subscription; no tests were executed by this reviewer and none are claimed. The b79 changes are not installed — this APPROVE asserts source readiness only, grants no hosted execution proof, live writer/limiter/unattended authority, or patient-launch standing, and all three suggestions accepted from the prior c5 review (uncaught subprocess errors, recovery-marker ambiguity, terminal-trigger and envelope cross-validation) are reconciled in this source.
